summary: Memory hydration is a precondition for governed writes on the Claude Code surface. Repository-write authority comes from Git (dedicated worktree + branch + merge analysis), NOT from memory state: a Graphiti phase-lock neither authorizes, denies, nor serializes ordinary repository mutation. Single front door: Cursor Graphiti (ops/graphiti/graphiti_memory_client.py) via thin hooks. Enforced at PreToolUse. Operator-only breakglass: L9_MEMORY_ENFORCEMENT_BREAKGLASS. No ENFORCEMENT=off side door.

prefetch.note: SessionStart thin wrap of Cursor Graphiti inject. Writes receipt on success. Fail-open.

gate.note: Emits a PreToolUse permissionDecision. Denies a matched governed write when its required preconditions are unmet.

writeback.note: Stop thin wrap of Cursor Graphiti write --kind session_summary. Fail-open.

session_prefetch.satisfied_by: a session receipt under state.session_receipt_glob whose session_id matches the current session and whose age is < state.session_ttl_seconds
session_prefetch.gate_shape: fresh hydration? yes -> continue; no -> hydrate, then continue
session_prefetch.note: The ONLY permitted memory precondition on repository mutation. There is no conflicts -> phase-lock -> edit-permission chain.

governed_writes.description: Edits to governance-authority paths require that memory was hydrated this session. Isolation and collision safety are Git's job (worktree + branch + publication gate).
Any other edit still requires that memory was prefetched this session.
Local history mutation and publication require session hydration only. Push/PR routing is governed by L4 and the publication gate, never by memory lock state.
External GitHub writes require session hydration only; collision safety comes from the publication overlap gate.

operator_override.note: Admin/operator-only key to the back door. Non-empty reason allows governed writes and appends .l9/memory/overrides.jsonl. Agents cannot set this for their own hooks. There is no L9_MEMORY_ENFORCEMENT=off escape hatch and no agent-facing force-lock.

repository_authority.note: Distinct authorities that MUST NOT be substituted for one another; see rules/96-multi-agent-main-bound-execution.mdc.
prohibited: memory conflict as a repository-wide mutation lock
branch identity as the memory namespace
